description_en: Fast, expressive styling for React. Server components, client components, streaming SSR, React Native—one API.
readme_excerpt: Fast, expressive styling for React. Server components, client components, streaming SSR, React Native: one API. styled-components is largely maintained by one person. Please help fund the project for consistent long-term support and updates: Open Collective Style React components with real CSS, scoped automatically and delivered only when needed. No class name juggling, no separate files, no build step required. - Works everywhere React runs. Server components, client components, streaming SSR,…
